name: Spring Agent Start Bridge
description: Authenticated HTTP bridge exposing OpenClaw tools to spring-agent-start.

serviceToken.description: Shared internal service token used by spring-agent-start.

gatewayToken.description: Gateway operator token used for tools.catalog and tools.invoke.

allowInstall.description: Allow trusted package installation through the bridge.
